name: implent
description: Two companions for building with AI: bearings lets people see the project, implementation-journal lets the next AI session pick up the work.

plugins.name: bearings
plugins.description: A visual map of a project that AI is building: its parts, a flow diagram of how each part works, and where recent work landed.

plugins.name: implementation-journal
plugins.description: Cross-session memory for AI coding work: task dossier, decisions-only log, restart-ready handoff, docs kept in step.
